# Bartosz Osiej — Docs

> Central documentation hub for all Bartosz Osiej projects — LinkShort,
> Novactorio, NV2 Engine, AURORA OS, the Cybersec Toolkit, Halcyon Process
> Monitor and the Externum programming language.

This site is fully readable by AI agents. For a single-file snapshot of all
content, fetch `/Docs/llms-full.txt`.

The site is bilingual: every page below has a Polish version under
`/Docs/pl/…` (e.g. `/Docs/pl/projects/fastapi-url/`).

## Tools

- [PDF Book & Translator](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/translator): read PDFs as visual books and translate pages in the browser — keyless (Google · MyMemory), no account.
  - [Polish](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/pl/translator)

## Projects

- [LinkShort (FastAPI-url)](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/fastapi-url/): Production-ready URL shortener — FastAPI, JWT auth, click tracking, React 19 SPA, SQLite.
  - [Getting Started](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/fastapi-url/getting-started)
  - [API Reference](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/fastapi-url/api-reference)
  - [Deployment](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/fastapi-url/deployment)
- [Novactorio (Factorio-web-game)](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/factorio-web-game/): Browser factory-automation game — hand-written Canvas 2D engine, TypeScript, Supabase co-op, Stripe premium.
  - [Architecture](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/factorio-web-game/architecture)
  - [Gameplay Systems](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/factorio-web-game/gameplay)
  - [Backend & Monetization](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/factorio-web-game/backend)
- [NV2 Engine (NV2_ENGINE)](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/nv2-engine/): Native Rust voxel engine — wgpu rendering, 97 block types, 9 biomes, AI-trained vegetation, water simulation.
  - [Architecture](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/nv2-engine/architecture)
  - [Gameplay](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/nv2-engine/gameplay)
  - [Blocks & Biomes](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/nv2-engine/blocks)
  - [Crafting Reference](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/nv2-engine/crafting)
  - [Water Simulation](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/nv2-engine/water)
  - [AI Vegetation System](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/nv2-engine/ai)
  - [Performance](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/nv2-engine/performance)
  - [Development](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/nv2-engine/development)
  - [Roadmap & Changelog](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/nv2-engine/roadmap)
- [Cybersec Toolkit (cybersec-tools)](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/cybersec-tools/): Four focused Rust security tools — TCP scanning, web vuln checks, hash cracking, pcap analysis.
  - [NetRecon](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/cybersec-tools/netrecon)
  - [ShadowScan](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/cybersec-tools/shadowscan)
  - [HashSleuth](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/cybersec-tools/hashsleuth)
  - [PacketEye](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/cybersec-tools/packeteye)
- [AURORA OS (AURORA-OS)](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/aurora-os/): A complete operating system in the browser — TypeScript kernel, window manager, virtual filesystem, 37-command shell, 8 apps, themes and procedural audio.
  - [Architecture](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/aurora-os/architecture)
  - [User Guide](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/aurora-os/user-guide)
- [Halcyon Process Monitor](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/halcyon-process-monitor/): Real-time eBPF process and file-op telemetry for Linux with a ransomware sliding-window heuristic and a ratatui TUI.
  - [Architecture](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/halcyon-process-monitor/architecture)
- [Externum](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/externum/): A programming language of our own — Python readability, binary performance and Bash control from a single source, compiled to three targets or run directly.
  - [Syntax Reference](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/externum/syntax)
  - [Examples](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/externum/examples)
  - [Compiler & CLI](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/externum/compiler)
  - [Architecture](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/externum/architecture)
- [N2 Mesh](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/n2-mesh/): Serverless P2P chat that runs on static hosting via WebRTC data channels with MQTT signaling (own repo).
